author: reek
body: Public entry point: return the best move index (0-8) for the board's current player, searching the complete game tree. The one book move is the empty board, where the search would visit nearly a million positions to conclude what is already known: the center is a perfect opening.

author: reek
body: Both seats play the full-depth search. Perfect play from both sides always ends in a draw - the only winning move is not to play.
